RESIDENTIAL LEASE AGREEMENT
This Residential Lease is made between Kenmore Properties Inc. ("Landlord") and the student named below ("Tenant") for the apartment at 12 Commonwealth Ave, Apt 3, Boston, Massachusetts (the "premises").
clauses.label: lawful

clauses.text: TERM. The term of this lease is twelve months, beginning September 1, 2026 and ending August 31, 2027.
clauses.label: lawful

clauses.text: RENT. Tenant shall pay rent of $3,400 per month, due on the first day of each month.
clauses.label: lawful

clauses.text: PAYMENTS AT SIGNING. At signing Tenant shall pay first month's rent of $3,400, last month's rent of $3,400, and a security deposit of $3,400.
clauses.label: lawful

clauses.text: PARKING. One parking space is included with the apartment. Tenant shall not park in spaces assigned to other units.
clauses.label: lawful

clauses.text: NOTICES. Repair requests and notices to Landlord shall be sent to Beacon Property Management, 100 Main Street, Boston, MA 02108, telephone (617) 555-0100, which manages the building for the owner.
clauses.label: lawful

clauses.text: SMOKING. Smoking of any substance is not permitted anywhere in the apartment or the building.
clauses.label: lawful

clauses.text: STATEMENT OF CONDITION. Landlord will give Tenant a written statement of the apartment's condition within ten days after the tenancy begins.
clauses.label: lawful

clauses.text: LANDLORD'S REPAIRS. Landlord shall keep the building and the apartment's heating, plumbing and electrical systems in good repair as required by the State Sanitary Code.
clauses.label: lawful

clauses.text: DAMAGE. Tenant shall pay the reasonable cost of repairing damage caused by Tenant or Tenant's guests, other than normal wear and tear.
clauses.label: lawful

clauses.text: RENTER'S INSURANCE. Tenant shall maintain renter's insurance covering Tenant's personal property throughout the tenancy.
clauses.label: lawful

clauses.text: NOISE. Tenant shall not make or allow noise that disturbs other residents, especially between 10 p.m. and 7 a.m.
clauses.label: lawful

clauses.text: ASSIGNMENT AND SUBLETTING. Tenant shall not assign this lease or sublet the apartment without Landlord's prior written consent.
clauses.label: lawful

RESIDENTIAL LEASE AGREEMENT
This Residential Lease is made between Fenway Residential LLC ("Landlord") and the student named below ("Tenant") for the apartment at 45 Gardner St, Unit 2, Boston, Massachusetts (the "premises").
clauses.label: lawful

clauses.text: TERM. The term of this lease is twelve months, beginning September 1, 2026 and ending August 31, 2027.
clauses.label: lawful

clauses.text: RENT. Tenant shall pay rent of $2,000 per month, due on the first day of each month.
clauses.label: lawful

clauses.text: PAYMENTS AT SIGNING. At signing Tenant shall pay first month's rent of $2,000 and a security deposit of $3,000.
clauses.label: possibly_unlawful

clauses.text: LEAD PAINT. The building was built before 1978. Before signing, Landlord gave Tenant the Tenant Lead Law Notification and the Tenant Certification form.
clauses.label: lawful

clauses.text: ASSIGNMENT AND SUBLETTING. Tenant shall not assign this lease or sublet the apartment without Landlord's prior written consent.
clauses.label: lawful

clauses.text: UTILITIES. Tenant shall pay for electricity, which is separately metered for the apartment and billed in Tenant's name. Landlord shall provide heat and hot water.
clauses.label: lawful

clauses.text: LATE PAYMENT. If rent is not received by the 5th day of the month, Tenant shall pay a late charge of $50, plus $10 for each additional day.
clauses.label: possibly_unlawful

clauses.text: DEPOSIT ACCOUNT. The security deposit will be held in a separate interest-bearing account at a Massachusetts bank, and Tenant will receive a receipt naming the bank, its address and the account number within thirty days.
clauses.label: lawful

clauses.text: STATEMENT OF CONDITION. Landlord will give Tenant a written statement of the apartment's condition within ten days after the tenancy begins.
clauses.label: lawful

clauses.text: PEST CONTROL. Tenant shall pay for all extermination and pest control, whatever the cause of the infestation.
clauses.label: possibly_unlawful

clauses.text: DAMAGE. Tenant shall pay the reasonable cost of repairing damage caused by Tenant or Tenant's guests, other than normal wear and tear.
clauses.label: lawful

RESIDENTIAL LEASE AGREEMENT
This Residential Lease is made between Fenway Residential LLC ("Landlord") and the student named below ("Tenant") for the apartment at 8 Linden St, Apt 1, Boston, Massachusetts (the "premises").
clauses.label: lawful

clauses.text: TERM. The term of this lease is twelve months, beginning September 1, 2026 and ending August 31, 2027.
clauses.label: lawful

clauses.text: RENT. Tenant shall pay rent of $2,700 per month, due on the first day of each month.
clauses.label: lawful

clauses.text: PAYMENTS AT SIGNING. Tenant shall pay an application fee of $50 and a move-in fee of $250, together with first month's rent of $2,700 and last month's rent of $2,700.

clauses.text: CONDITION AND REPAIRS. Tenant accepts the apartment as is and shall be responsible for all repairs, including the heating, plumbing and electrical systems.
clauses.label: possibly_unlawful

clauses.text: ASSIGNMENT AND SUBLETTING. Tenant shall not assign this lease or sublet the apartment without Landlord's prior written consent.
clauses.label: lawful

clauses.text: CLEANING. $300 of the security deposit is a non-refundable cleaning fee that Landlord will keep at the end of the tenancy regardless of the apartment's condition.
clauses.label: possibly_unlawful

clauses.text: ALTERATIONS. Tenant shall not paint, install fixtures or make alterations to the apartment without Landlord's written consent.
clauses.label: lawful

clauses.text: GUESTS. Tenant may not have overnight guests for more than three nights in any month without Landlord's written permission.
clauses.label: unusual

clauses.text: STATEMENT OF CONDITION. Landlord will give Tenant a written statement of the apartment's condition within ten days after the tenancy begins.
clauses.label: lawful

clauses.text: NOTICE OF MOVE-OUT. Tenant must give Landlord 60 days' written notice before moving out at the end of the lease term.
clauses.label: unusual

clauses.text: PARKING. One parking space is included with the apartment. Tenant shall not park in spaces assigned to other units.
clauses.label: lawful

clauses.text: CLEANLINESS. Tenant shall keep the apartment clean and sanitary and shall put all trash and recycling in the containers provided.
clauses.label: lawful

clauses.text: LEAD PAINT. The building was built before 1978. Before signing, Landlord gave Tenant the Tenant Lead Law Notification and the Tenant Certification form.
clauses.label: lawful

clauses.text: NON-PAYMENT. If Tenant fails to pay rent, Landlord may change the locks and remove Tenant's belongings without going to court.
clauses.label: possibly_unlawful

RESIDENTIAL LEASE AGREEMENT
This Residential Lease is made between Kenmore Properties Inc. ("Landlord") and the student named below ("Tenant") for the apartment at 8 Linden St, Apt 1, Boston, Massachusetts (the "premises").
clauses.label: lawful

clauses.text: TERM. The term of this lease is twelve months, beginning September 1, 2026 and ending August 31, 2027.
clauses.label: lawful

clauses.text: RENT. Tenant shall pay rent of $2,300 per month, due on the first day of each month.
clauses.label: lawful

clauses.text: PAYMENTS AT SIGNING. At signing Tenant shall pay first month's rent of $2,300, last month's rent of $2,300, a security deposit of $2,300, and $85 for the purchase and installation of a new lock and key.
clauses.label: lawful

clauses.text: NOTICES. Repair requests and notices to Landlord shall be sent to Beacon Property Management, 100 Main Street, Boston, MA 02108, telephone (617) 555-0100, which manages the building for the owner.
clauses.label: lawful

clauses.text: ASSIGNMENT AND SUBLETTING. Tenant shall not assign this lease or sublet the apartment without Landlord's prior written consent.
clauses.label: lawful

clauses.text: ACCESS. Landlord may enter the apartment at reasonable times, with 24 hours' notice except in an emergency, to inspect it, make repairs, or show it to prospective tenants or buyers.
clauses.label: lawful

clauses.text: RETURN OF DEPOSIT. Landlord shall return the security deposit, with interest, within thirty days after the tenancy ends, less only the deductions allowed by law, itemized as the law requires.
clauses.label: lawful

clauses.text: CLEANLINESS. Tenant shall keep the apartment clean and sanitary and shall put all trash and recycling in the containers provided.
clauses.label: lawful

clauses.text: PEST CONTROL. Tenant shall pay for all extermination and pest control, whatever the cause of the infestation.
clauses.label: possibly_unlawful

clauses.text: LAUNDRY. Coin-operated washers and dryers are available in the basement for the use of all tenants.
clauses.label: lawful

clauses.text: LEAD PAINT. The building was built before 1978. Before signing, Landlord gave Tenant the Tenant Lead Law Notification and the Tenant Certification form.
clauses.label: lawful
